mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypovolemia and electrolyte depletion may increase doxycycline photosensitivity risk and reduce renal clearance; doxycycline can cause esophageal irritation exacerbated by dehydration from loop diuretics.
action: Monitor fluid and electrolyte status closely; ensure adequate hydration; counsel patient on sun protection and taking doxycycline with full glass of water in upright position; consider alternative antibiotics if renal function deteriorates.
